usage: 中國 (zung1 gwok3) is a noun that refers to the country China.
You can use 中國 to talk about the country itself or things related to China.
When mentioning 中國, it often functions as the subject or object in a sentence.
It can be combined with other words to form names of places or cultural references related to China.
Use 中國 when talking about geography, nationality, culture, or politics related to the country.
